review: Worst experience on a shopping app ever. First the product shown in pictures is totally different from what arrives. If you try to return you might have to try couple of times to place the request. It doesn't ends thr, you have to call multiple times to the help desk to atleast pick up the return, lemme tell you, they don't bother listening. Everytime they say the complaint had been registered and we'll see to it but nobody sees. At the end you hard earned money is wasted on bad quality stuff.

I had been using the app for over 2 years and the experience was quite good. The products were of decent quality as well. But lately, I had been receiving multiple wrong orders and as I tried to return them, my account got flagged. However, the most disappointing thing here is that, one may never know when his/her account may get flagged. They offer no intimation and no solution at all. Once the account gets flagged, there is hardly any solution to access the app again.

The price is fair and cheap. One can easily buy products here but as a customer I faced a ridiculous issue in the app. And it happened to me 2-3 times. The problem was, when I requested for exchange the product was picked up within 24 hours but the exchanged item was delivered after a week or so, and additionally, a completely different product was delivered. And when I requested to return the pickup guy refuse to take that product.....

The catalogue of dresses isn't enough especially for plus size people. There is no filter to select XL or XXL dresses. Most of the dresses here are mainly of small or medium size only. Very disappointing. Edit 2: also it would be great if the app UI in enhanced. It's not bad but you could definitely work more to make it look sophisticated and premium.

Worst and horrible experience on this app. The product shown in images does'nt match in real. In images product looks good but when we received it ,its totally different .In many cases there is size issues even if you order the same size .Most of the times the colour was different .Terms and policy of this aap are very bad,even if you did 'nt like the product you cannot return it because of their terms and conditions.They can even cancel your account as per there wish ,thats the very bad thing

It says easy returns but Nooo! I've paid extra amount also to have easy return but the size didn't fit and I've been trying to return the product from more than 3 weeks. They are assigning delivery partner but no one is coming to pick up. When trying to contact the delivery agent they aren't answering. The call option in the customer support section of the app doesn't work no matter how many times I've put the request and in multiple languages too. Wondering is this how they are selling millions

(edited review) meesho has many many choices to select from. 2/10 items delivered are incorrect or not of good quality. What I don't like is that the sellers cancel the order without reasons. The main problem is with their courier partners (Bangalore City experience), especially shafowfax. They throw the covers near the door after return pickup and are extremely rude, unprofessional and disrespectful towards customers. Please change your delivery partners. For these reasons, I'm removing 3 stars

Been shopping online for years now and by far the most horrible experience. Total different product received. Very misleading images shown on the app. The quality is very bad. The packaging was destroyed when delivered plus the product was broken. Even after sending all the products back for refund got refunded only for one item. Stupid policies put in place. Even renound marketplaces are not so rigid with their technical policies. Would never recommend this app to anyone.

I found errors in the price calculation in Meesho app. With your last update on the app it is showing wrong price. For a product worth actual price 398rs, after adding coins it showed 358rs and when added to cart it suddenly changes to 400rs.I have attached a video for the same. I tried multiple times by adding and removing products but no use. Please bring back the sort options for image search. After the last updates sort option for image search is missing. Its hard to use without sorting.

This app is not good at all, I just bought a product and chose 'all issue easy return allowed' and I paid full price after other discounts that did not include the 'only wrong/defect items allowed' discount at all. So, when I tried to return it, it says that only wrong/defect items are allowed or exchange is allowed. So, I contacted the help line no. and they told me they can't help. So, even though it's not my fault I have to suffer the consequences.
